payload.friendly_name: A WP leaves review or approval only through a recorded verdict or an operator force with a note
payload.purpose_context: agent action implement silently force-moves a WP out of for_review, in_review or approved with a fabricated rework reason (#5446, P0). The forced exit then deadlocks every later approval. Fold in the single implementer-of-record authority (#5340), the forced-approval restamp residual (#5721) and the review-cycle-1 overwrite (#5194).
payload.purpose_tldr: Stop any agent from pulling a work package out of review or approval without a recorded verdict, and repair the review-cycle surfaces that break after it happens.

payload.question: Which issues does the mission close and what is out of scope?

payload.final_answer: Close #5446 (core guard + approval deadlock repair + --force/--note escape hatch), #5340 (one implementer-of-record authority), #5194 (review-cycle artifact never overwritten); #5721 only the forced-approval restamp part in reach, rest stays as recorded residual. Out: #5819 #5468 #5804 #5467 #5820 #5796 #5099 #4941 and the spec-kitty-events reducer.

payload.question: What should agent action implement do for a WP in for_review, in_review and approved?

payload.final_answer: in_review: claim conflict naming the reviewer. approved: refuse, pointing at move-task --to planned --review-feedback-file. for_review: only the implementer of record may withdraw it back to in_progress. No fabricated rejection reason anywhere.

payload.question: How does an operator override the guard?

payload.final_answer: agent action implement --force --note <text>: --note is required with --force and is threaded into the event reason; the actor is recorded.

payload.wp_title: Approval works after a forced review exit
Forced approvals do not restamp the approval bound
Review-exit guard and operator force with a note
